verdict.rationale: No evidence pack item mentions any migration tool, import wizard, dotfiles sync, or settings/file transfer mechanism for moving from an old computer to a new Omarchy install. Snapshots (omarchy-docs-11) only cover backup/restore on the same install lifecycle, not cross-machine migration. missing for 10: any migration/import feature, dotfiles/settings sync tool, cross-machine file transfer utility, or documentation addressing switcher onboarding from another OS/computer.
